genre.zh: 南法小酒館美食雜誌（Bon Appétit 那種）
genre.en: a Provençal bistro feature in the manner of Bon Appétit: the real dining room, wine and bread on the table, late-afternoon sun

s: the plate on a linen-covered table on a terrace, hard late Provence-style sun from one side, a glass of white wine casting a long amber shadow
shot from directly overhead on a terracotta tablecloth: two hands with knife and fork poised over the plate, hard sun with crisp shadows
